definitions.explanation: The action of focusing awareness on something.
A statement to alert someone about something.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
{先生|せんせい}に{注意|ちゅうい}された。
examples.english: I was warned by the teacher.

examples.japanese: {注意|ちゅうい}して{歩|ある}いてください。
{電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{騒|さわ}いでいた{人|ひと}が{注意|ちゅうい}された。
examples.english: The person making noise on the train was warned.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}に{注意|ちゅうい}している。
examples.english: I pay attention to my health.

examples.japanese: {遅刻|ちこく}が{多|おお}いので、{上司|じょうし}に{注意|ちゅうい}された。
examples.english: I was warned by my boss because I was often late.

notes:
{注意|ちゅうい} has two main uses: paying attention to something, or warning/cautioning someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{注意|ちゅうい}する: to pay attention to, watch out for
- 〜を{注意|ちゅうい}する: to warn/scold someone
- {注意|ちゅうい}して〜: to do something carefully

POLITE FORMS:
- ご{注意|ちゅうい}ください: please be careful
- お{気|き}をつけください: please take care (similar)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う: to pay attention
- {注意|ちゅうい}を{引|ひ}く: to attract attention
- {注意|ちゅうい}{事項|じこう}: precautions, notes
